comparison.objective: Extract exactly one paper cup from a wall dispenser and stand it on a mat.
comparison.physical_skill: Apply controlled pull through a compliant gasket while avoiding crushing or disturbing nested cups, then place upright.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly one undamaged cup removed and upright on the mat; remaining cups retained; no drop, crush, or extra extraction.
comparison.reason: It tests singular extraction from a nested stack and placement, not separating two loose-body populations through a screen.
